notes: a second audit pass: stopping a run while the model was mid tool-call no longer poisons the chat (the half-written call used to stay behind with nothing answering it, and every later message failed); Stop now closes an open permission prompt instead of leaving the chat waiting behind a modal; file history records the chat whose run is writing rather than the chat on screen, so a background chat's writes land in its own Files-changed list; web_fetch through a connected browser tab asks the same forced question http_request already did, because it reads whatever that login can read; removing a plugin deletes its stored credentials; the connector extension ships with access to nothing and asks per site, and its replies reach a harness opened from a file at all; the plan-execute permission lift applies to the chat executing the plan instead of every chat running; git_log stops re-reading its whole frontier on every commit and the git caches refresh from every entry point; chats, repository caches and file indexes are evicted instead of held for the life of the tab; pdf.js, JSZip and SheetJS are pinned by checksum; the dev server stops serving files outside the repo; and a new chat sweeps away the empty ones left behind it
